title: Damage-Aware Bandit Pruning for Vision and Language Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2609.05448v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Structured post-training pruning of transformers requires selecting complete functional units whose suppression causes limited degradation. We formulate structured-unit selection for language and vision transformers as a damage-aware multi-armed bandit problem under a fixed candidate-evaluation budget. Attention heads and MLP channel groups are temporarily masked on calibration batches. Paired damage is the masked loss minus the base loss on the same batch, reducing batch-to-batch variation. A smooth bounded reward drives either a UCB-style policy or fractional-Beta Thompson Sampling, and the final mask is constructed sequentially by adding one unit at each step. The selected units are functionally zeroed in the original dense checkpoint; therefore, the reported parameter effects represent effective structural suppression rather than physical compression or measured speedup. Experiments on WikiText-2, LAMBADA, and Imagenette cover GPT-2,

translated_title: 面向视觉与语言Transformer的损伤感知赌博机剪枝方法
translated_abstract: Transformer的结构化训练后剪枝需要选择那些被抑制后仅造成有限性能下降的完整功能单元。我们将语言和视觉Transformer的结构化单元选择形式化为固定候选评估预算下的损伤感知多臂赌博机问题。在校准批次上临时掩蔽注意力头和MLP通道组，配对损伤定义为同一批次上掩蔽后的损失减去基准损失，从而减少批次间的波动。一个平滑有界的奖励驱动UCB风格的策略或分数Beta汤普森采样，最终掩蔽通过每步添加一个单元的方式顺序构建。所选单元在原始稠密模型检查点中被功能性地置零；因此，报告的参数效应代表有效的结构性抑制，而非物理压缩或实测加速。在WikiText-2、LAMBADA和Imagenette上的实验涵盖了GPT-2等模型。
tldr: 提出了一种损伤感知的多臂赌博机框架，通过配对损伤评估和UCB/分数Beta汤普森采样策略，在固定评估预算下为视觉和语言Transformer选择抑制后性能损失最小的结构单元（注意力头和MLP通道组）。
en_tdlr: Proposes a damage-aware multi-armed bandit framework that leverages paired damage estimation and UCB-style or fractional-Beta Thompson Sampling policies to select structurally suppressible units (attention heads and MLP channel groups) in vision and language transformers under a fixed candidate-evaluation budget.
